visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men sit on a grey sofa behind a light-colored wooden table in a studio setting. The man on the left wears a bright yellow shirt, the middle one has wavy shoulder-length hair and a striped shirt, and the right one wears a dark grey shirt. They look directly at the camera in a brightly lit indoor environment with a white lamp. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up shot where hands hold a large green bag of durian-flavored Lay's potato chips and a smaller box of coriander-flavored fries. The background is a kitchen area with wooden cabinets and glassware visible. Large yellow variety text overlays the food products in the frame center. (3) Back to the medium shot of the three men sitting together. They are now holding small individual green snack packets and eating the fries. Graphical icons of lemons and coriander sprigs appear on the left side of the screen with mathematical arrows indicating flavor profiles. Their facial expressions show curiosity. (4) The scene shifts to the man in the grey shirt gagging. He is bent over a white wooden table with a pink-lined trash can next to it. He holds his hand over his mouth while the others are heard laughing. The setting is a living room area with indoor plants and wooden doors. (5) The finale features a handheld, shaky camera following the man in the grey shirt as he aggressively chases another man through a kitchen area. He holds the open bag of durian chips toward the camera lenses. Speed line graphics and large text overlays like 'HOW DARE YOU' appear in the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male vocal starts with a sharp attack. Upbeat electronic pop background music with a strong rhythmic 4/4 beat enters immediately. A synthetic 'whoosh' sound effect marks the first transition. The vocal is clear with high intensity and moderate pitch throughout this segment. (2) A second male voice responds with lower arousal but clear articulation. A metallic 'ding' sound effect coincides with a visual shift to the product. The background music remains constant in the mix at a moderate loudness ratio. No meaningful ambient noise is present. (3) Multiple voices overlap as they taste the food products. A distinct 'crunch' incidental sound is heard from the snacking. The background music swells slightly in volume. Vocal pitch variability increases as they describe the flavors. A digital UI 'blip' sound effect occurs. (4) A loud, guttural gagging sound indicating high arousal triggers a new phase. This is immediately followed by the percussive sound of a plastic trash can lid opening. Background laughter from an added sound effect track is prominent. The main background music continues without any interruption. (5) A chaotic vocal environment follows with shouting and rapid speech. A 'scream' vocal effect is heard. Rapid-fire hard cuts in the audio track correspond with the visual movement. High-frequency digital 'ping' sound effects occur repeatedly. The track ends with a fast fade-out of laughter and music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic food review vlog where three influencers taste unusual potato chip flavors (coriander and durian) by Lay's. It aims to entertain the audience through their genuine and exaggerated reactions, contrasting the 'elegant' coriander chips with the 'repulsive' durian chips, using high-energy editing and variety sound effects to drive engagement.
